question.worked_solution:
We need to solve the equation $Ax=0.$ First, we find the row echelon form of $A$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 1 \\ 7 & -7 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-7){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

This corresponds to the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=0 \\ 0=0\end{aligned}
$$

The basic variables are the variables whose coefficients are pivots. In this case, the basic variable is ${x}_{1}$, and we have two free variables, ${x}_{2}$ and ${x}_{3}.$ That means we need to find ${x}_{1}$ in terms of ${x}_{2}$ and ${x}_{3}.$

From the first equation we get ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}-{x}_{3},$ so the set of all the solutions of $Ax=0$ is

$$
\text{Null}(A)=\{[\begin{aligned}{x}_{2}-{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]\,:\,{x}_{2},{x}_{3}\in R\}.
$$
